display.purpose: Wordmark and every heading (h1, h2, home hero). The one heading face in the app; never used for labels, buttons, or body copy.

ui.purpose: Body copy, labels, buttons, nav, list descriptions. Default document font.

mono.purpose: Every textarea/input that holds or produces tool data (JSON, Base64, hashes, UUIDs, timestamps), plus the small route tag on each home row. Content in a code face, not a technical costume.

shadows.name: header-separation-dark
shadows.purpose: Sticky app-shell header lift on cool slate. Dark-tinted; the light-theme hairline shadow is invisible on #0d1117.

shadows.name: header-separation-light
shadows.purpose: Sticky app-shell header lift on warm paper. html[data-theme=light] only.

shadows.name: row-raised
shadows.purpose: Home tool-row hover/focus-visible, paired with the background shift to --surface.

shadows.name: group-ring
shadows.purpose: Home accordion group header band. Ring via box-shadow so a 1px border does not shift the label off the origin edge. Brass ring on hover/focus.

motion.name: row-hover
motion.purpose: Home tool-row hover/focus-visible, paired with the chevron fade/slide (opacity + transform, 160ms ease-out).

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: Primary button hover/active: fill brightens and lifts 1px (translateY(-1px)).

motion.name: field-focus
motion.purpose: Textarea/input/select focus; the focus-visible outline itself appears instantly, only the border color eases.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled brass action (Format / Run / Generate / Hash / Convert / Transform). Dark ink on brass. Disabled at 50% opacity.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brass); color: var(--brass-ink); border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-6); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--brass-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Data Textarea
components.description: Every tool's input/output field. Recessed well (--bg) inside a raised --surface panel, monospace for the data it holds.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-textarea" rows="4" aria-label="Example input" placeholder="Paste here"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-textarea { width: 100%; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: var(--space-3); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--text-sm); transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { border-color: var(--brass-strong); outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Home Tool Row
components.description: Full-width linked row inside a home accordion group. No card, no border-left accent; hover/focus raises the row to --surface and reveals an authored chevron.
components.html: JSON formatterPretty-print or minify JSON in your browser./tools/json-formatter
components.css: .ds-tool-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-4); padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-3); text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: inherit; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-tool-row__title { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-tool-row__description { display: block; font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: var(--space-1); } .ds-tool-row__path { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--text-tertiary); } .ds-tool-row__chevron { color: var(--brass-strong); opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-2px); transition: opacity 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-tool-row:hover, .ds-tool-row:focus-visible { background-color: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); } .ds-tool-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool-row:hover .ds-tool-row__chevron, .ds-tool-row:focus-visible .ds-tool-row__chevron { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

components.name: Tool Group Header
components.description: Home accordion <summary>. Raised --surface band, display 700, line-strong ring; brass ring on hover/focus. Chevron instant, no extra motion.
components.css: .ds-group { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-4); width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-3); border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong), 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); } .ds-group svg { color: var(--brass-strong); } .ds-group:hover, .ds-group:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--brass-strong), 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); } .ds-group:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Header 36×36 cycle Dark → Light → System. Moon / sun / monitor. Icon swap instant. Hairline --line; brass icon; hover fill via color-mix.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Theme: Dark" title="Theme: Dark"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 14.5A8.5 8.5 0 1 1 9.5 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 14.5z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--brass-strong); cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-toggle svg { display: block; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--brass-strong); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent); } .ds-theme-toggle:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 10%, transparent); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Io Panel Card
components.description: Raised --surface card for tool input/output (shadcn Card). Recessed --bg wells sit inside. Hairline --line, radius-md.
components.css: .ds-io-panel { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--space-6); } .ds-io-panel__label { display: block; font-size: var(--text-xs); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-tertiary); margin-bottom: var(--space-3); }

narrative.overview: GJB Toolbox is a small bench of hand tools you reach for mid-task, not a SaaS product with a home screen to check daily. Default is cool slate (#0d1117 / #161b22) — an explicit product choice. Light remains the daylight workshop: warm pale-yellow paper, same brass/copper accent as sunlit metal. Dark uses the same brass fill on a cool wash. Visitor cycles Dark → Light → System via one header icon. Data (JSON, hashes, UUIDs, timestamps) is set in JetBrains Mono because it is code and data.
keyCharacteristics: Default cool slate; light is warm pale-yellow paper — same brass accent in both
One brass/copper accent, used only for primary actions, hover/current state, and focus
Two surfaces only (--bg, --surface) reused in each theme instead of a multi-step scale
Header icon cycles Dark → Light → System; only localStorage key is gjb-theme
Authored SVG chevron for navigation; Lucide only for generic in-tool Copy/Trash
Exactly three intentional micro-interactions; theme icon swap is instant

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The brass accent is reserved for primary actions, current/hover state, and focus. It never decorates static content.

rules.name: The Authored Icon Rule
rules.body: Navigation icons are hand-drawn single-stroke SVG. No unicode arrows or emoji. Lucide Copy/Trash is a scoped exception for generic in-tool actions.

rules.name: The Theme-Enum Rule
rules.body: Theme preference may be persisted only as localStorage gjb-theme (dark | light | system). No other keys. Tool input still dies on refresh.

rules.name: The Three-Motion Rule
rules.body: Row hover, button hover, and field focus are the only transitions in the system. Theme icon swap is instant. No page-load choreography.

dos: Do reuse the two surfaces (--bg, --surface) instead of inventing a third grey.
Do set data-bearing textarea/input content in the mono face; it is content, not decoration.
Do give every interactive control a positive, visible focus-visible outline (2-3px offset, never inside the control).
Do persist theme only as gjb-theme; never tool input, recents, or accordion state.
donts: Don't use purple/indigo tints, cream-paper + terracotta serif warmth, or a flat white void.
Don't add glowing neon edges, GitHub-blue glows, or halos — shadows carry an offset and a soft blur.
Don't reach for a unicode glyph (arrows, braces, emoji) as a stand-in icon.
Don't add a card-grid homepage, a kicker/eyebrow label, or a colored border-left accent.
Don't ship warm-walnut night or a header-only invert — full chrome + fields follow the resolved theme.
